summary: Primary-source review since 2026-11-15 found no newly verified material AI-specific realized-employment evidence changing Career Radar. BLS October payrolls (Nov 6), OECD unemployment release (Nov 10), and earlier ILO AI exposure/adoption research do not establish AI-caused job displacement. Existing OECD, ILO, IMF and BLS evidence is not duplicated; online job postings are not payroll employment, and forecasts/exposure/surveys are not observed displacement.
